children: According to CNBC, U.S. equity futures were near flat Wednesday night as traders looked ahead to Anthropic’s Nasdaq debut Thursday under the ticker “ANT.” A person familiar with the matter said Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, above the expected range. Dow futures rose 35 points, or 0.07%, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures each added 0.1%. In Wednesday’s regular session, the Dow fell more than 560 points, or 1.1%, the S&P 500 lost 0.2% for a fifth consecutive decline, and the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.4%.

title: Stock Futures Hold Near Flat as Anthropic Prices IPO at $83 Ahead of Debut
